findings_resolved: Seven wallets exceeded front boundaries; 00586 also had an internal schedule-height overlap and truncated source wording. No font reduction or change to 85.6 x 54 mm panels.
Eleven bound handbooks omitted real supportive-care phase sheets; corrected section recomposition includes their complete authored PDF pages.
Twenty-one reference pages lacked the rich anatomy section; rendered reference and bound handbooks updated.
00227 duplicate/coincident skin markers separated: approved pin 5 now hands-feet at23,56; remaining pin coordinates retained.
00558/colorectal42-day and00890 28-day print charts overflowed horizontally; exact authored day spans and instructions converted to printable tables.
All41guide marker digits were crossed by connector lines because a parent stacking context trapped pins beneath the SVG; print-only stacking fix corrected just guide anatomy page and bound copy.
00421continuous/00555 and00783 48-hour pump information replaced generic46-hour headings in standalone and bound logistics pages.
00448 duplicated support paragraph removed in source-authored standalone PDF and rebound handbook.
00216 and00692 full contemporary guide/wallet/reference/handbook assets generated from frozen profiles and final compiled journeys.
limits: This verifies PDF content retention, print layout, local QR destinations and artifact consistency; it is not independent clinical approval.
Not every page of all3277pages was viewed manually; all received automated nonempty/bounds/mirror checks, with individual guide maps and representative changed documents inspected visually.
Inherited full-reference editorial refinements remain: repeated overview/full timeline and occasional screen-oriented wording. No scientific content was discarded to reduce length.
Canonical deployed QR URL responses, real camera scanning, home-screen installation and physical printing require separate evidence.
